Scott Kupor (@skupor) was the first hire at Andreessen Horowitz. Marc and Ben still joke that if he had said yes sooner, the firm would be called Andreessen, Kupor, Horowitz.

His job description: "We're going to invest, and you need to figure out everything else."

Scott spent 16 years helping grow a16z from 3 people to about 700. Now he runs the Office of Personnel Management, the HR department for 2 million federal employees.

Scott explains how a16z borrowed Michael Ovitz's playbook from CAA, why only 7% of the federal workforce is under 30, and why 400 million pages of retirement records sit in an underground limestone mine in Pennsylvania.

This is a fascinating conversation about incentives, talent, and what it takes to turn a 2.3-million-person oil tanker.

In response to the recent market volatility across $TSM to $SKHY to Innolight:

- Taiwan to restrict borrowed share short selling from 30% -> 3% relative to order volumes (90% reduction),  effective Nov 9th. 

Taiwan is separately raising its minimum collateral requirement from 90% to 130% for margin short selling.

And authorized the $15.3B stabilization fund for Government buying in the stock market. 

- South Korea to waive 140% margin-loan collateral maintenance for 3 months to reduce forced selling, effective Nov 9th. 

- China introduced a series of stock-market support package aimed at stabilizing equities. People's Bank of China introduced a $15 billion liquidity-swap operation for securities firms and fund managers.

As well as reduced lending rates for the share buybacks and shareholder purchase programs from 1.25% -> 1% this month. 

_

下午跟几位熬夜不睡觉的美国老哥，打了电话，聊了聊这波叫停 AI、数据中心潮，他们说身边绝大多数本地居民和同事，都非常支持暂停这东西。

因为它不仅让当地人，支付了更多的电费，而且这玩意也无法产生大量就业。

而科技创业者们又天天炫耀，自家靠 AI 裁员了很多人，结合不断上涨的物价，让大家极为抵触。

站在不炒股，只是普通打工人的视角，AI 革命的新闻，反而增加人们进一步负面的看法，毕竟世界上互联网从业者仍是极少数。

最倒霉的就是本来在农场好好住的老哥，几十年下来，社区一直非常安逸，然后突然发现自家社区不远荒置的农场，盖了超大数据中心，不停的施工，不断出入的卡车，大老远就能听到轰鸣声，根本无法让人安心休息。

而且他们给我讲了一个案例，说是某个地方开发商跟地方官员签了保密协议，居民最后才知道，然后这事闹的很大，导致大家更加对此进行排斥。

所以既然阻止不了，就干脆全投民主党，也不管民主党什么政策，只要把支持 AI 和数据中心的，搞下去就行，于是就上演了本轮的中期选举结果。

Starlink is bringing internet access to remote classrooms in Indonesia

Katingan’s local government is distributing Starlink kits to preschools, elementary schools and junior high schools across areas where traditional internet remains weak or unavailable

In 2026, Katingan received 287 Starlink units in total

Of those, 174 were allocated to education including PAUD, elementary schools, junior high schools and regional education coordinators

For teachers and students, that means access to digital learning materials, online references and school services that were much harder to reach before

A single Starlink connection opens up an entire classroom to the world
